thought.text: The `--help` abort is expected — this is a GUI app with no `--help` flag, and I didn't set `DISPLAY`. Let me clean up my background processes and do one final, clean verification with the display present.

reasoning_content:
The `python -m pomodoro --help` command failed because there was no DISPLAY set (Xvfb is on :99). That's expected — this is a GUI app, and there's no `--help` flag; it just tried to open the window. That's not a failure; the app requires a display. Let me clean up the background processes I started and do a final proper verification with the DISPLAY set.

Let me kill the background app and Xvfb, and do a clean final check.

action.command: cd /workspace && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 8 ./.venv/bin/pomodoro >/tmp/pom2.log 2>&1 & APP=$!; sleep 5; if kill -0 $APP 2>/dev/null; then echo "VERIFIED: pomodoro running on DISPLAY=:99 (pid $APP)"; kill $APP 2>/dev/null; else echo "not running"; fi; sleep 1; echo "--- log ---"; cat /tmp/pom2.log
